## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle Sòng-dynasty annotated commentary on the *Fànwǎng jīng*, with elaborate textual apparatus integrating the parent text, the major Tang commentary ([法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's *Fànwǎngjīng púsàjièběn shū* [KR6k0080](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0080)), and explanatory annotations. Compiled by **Yǔ Xián** 與咸 ([與咸](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%88%87%E5%92%B8)) of the Sòng. The compositional method (入疏箋經加註釋疏) reflects an elaborate synoptic format combining sūtra, commentary, and gloss.

**Abstract**

The text is one of the more elaborate Sòng-period commentary compendia on the *Fànwǎng jīng*. It reflects the scholastic integration achieved by Sòng-period Buddhist exegetes, who combined the major Tang commentary lineages into multi-layered synoptic editions facilitating instructional use.
